title: Necessity of the q_d Loss in XOR3-Based nAE Security
summary: The nAE security bound has a multiplicative qd loss, but whether this loss is necessary or merely a proof artifact remains open.

formal_statement.body: For the favored ivE $+$ vecMAC compositions realized with the XOR3 construction, the security bound under a single-decryption-query characterization of nAE security incurs a multiplicative $q_d$ loss attributed to the weaker nAE-security definition; determine whether this $q_d$ factor is an artifact of the proof or is necessary under that characterization.

scope.domain: Nonce-based authenticated-encryption security for favored ivE + vecMAC compositions realized with XOR3.
assumptions: A single-decryption-query characterization of nAE security.
parameters: q_d: quantity appearing as a multiplicative loss in the security bound
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether the q_d loss is an artifact of the proof or necessary under the stated characterization.

progress.summary: The source reports a quantitative q_d loss attributed to the weaker nAE definition and explicitly states that it has not determined whether the loss is artifactual or necessary.
citation_labels: Chanathip Namprempre et al., Reconsidering Generic Composition
